_what: The catalogue screens and the reads they draw from, published to the Marketplace by the Marketplace publisher account (src/marketplace-defaults.json MARKETPLACE_PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT_ID) through the ordinary publish_tool road after each release switch (scripts/publish-marketplace-screens.mjs). A screen row's screen is { kind: "reads", reads: [{ id, tool, input }], layout }: the generic screen host (src/screen-host.mjs) runs each read for the asking account and draws the layout (src/screen-layout.mjs) from what they answered. A read is an ordinary tool whose account action answers at the asking account (src/screen-reads.mjs). The words a screen shows are its layout's. A reads screen may carry shown_when, a binding over what its reads answered; when it is not true the host answers Not found. tool:screen-picture is the one row here that is not a screen: it draws one of the asking person's own screens (src/screen-pictures.mjs), the browser's /work/api/screen-picture. A screen row runs as its one read does (the same input_schema, account action invoke and sample-run verify), so save_tool and publish_tool check it like any tool; tool:screen-picture's sample asks for an address that is not a screen, the one drawing an AI's key may run.
